title: Navy aviators privately report regular sightings and near misses

tellings.quote:
and they told us that they saw they were
seeing uh phenomena that they couldn't
understand on a very regular basis but
they were not talking about that.

plain: Navy pilots at a US Navy base privately said they were seeing things in the sky they could not understand "on a very regular basis", including near misses, but were not talking about it openly. A guest identified as Dr. Gilbert tells Michels he heard this from the aviators directly. If true, it would mean such encounters are common among military pilots but kept quiet.
